question: How should the breath be drawn in at the root of the tongue and palate?
premises: The practice is located at the root of tongue and palate
The breath is to be taken in
The action must be done slowly
inference: One should place awareness at the root of the tongue and palate and slowly drink in the breath.
plain_english: Placing it at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
